text: I dreamt that I'm visiting you at your house. I don't know how I got in. There was a long corridor. I walked through it. It led to the kitchen, which was narrow, like a continuation of the corridor, with no windows. Your house had no windows. It was messy, but very clean, and everything looked brand new, unused. It was like a film set or a showroom. And when I looked in the sink, I was in the kitchen. When I looked in the sink, I saw a pile of dishes, but they weren't dirty. They had a bunch of plastic, fake plastic fruit and veg, and even fake meat, like a burger or something. I could smell the newness of the material, as if it was fresh from a factory. It was all fake, and I heard someone talking, so I kept walking. I was looking for you. The kitchen led to the only room in the house, a very large room, also with no windows. The walls were padded, like a recording studio, but I didn't see any recording equipment. I saw the back of you. You didn't notice me standing there. You were watching a little screen. It was a film. They were watching a film. I wasn't sure I was supposed to be there. You were completely absorbed in that film. I was trying to see what you were watching, and when I came closer, I saw a figure that looked kind of familiar. I was trying to figure out where I recognized it from. I could suddenly hear her voice very clearly, but I couldn't make out what she was saying. Then I realized it was me. It was me. She sounded exactly like me. At that point, you turned around, and you looked at me. It was you.
